title: Reading Drill — Reducing repeated journeys to a tool shed — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Reducing repeated journeys to a tool shed — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The allotment committee in Cairnford received an old report about gardeners discovering that the right tools are already borrowed. The report compared extra trips per afternoon, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the checkout records rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered three weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include occasional large classes. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed a board listing tools in use as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
